tasks.name: turning_on_radio
tasks.instruction: Turn on the radio receiver that's on the table in the living room.

tasks.name: picking_up_trash
tasks.instruction: Put the three cans of soda from the living room inside the trash can in the kitchen.

tasks.name: putting_away_Halloween_decorations
tasks.instruction: Place each of the two pumpkins and all three candles from the living room inside a cabinet in the living room (use any cabinet), then make sure every cabinet is closed, and position the cauldron so it is next to a table in the living room.

tasks.name: cleaning_up_plates_and_food
tasks.instruction: From the breakfast table in the kitchen, move both pizzas - keeping each on its plate - into the same refrigerator, put both bowls into one sink, and make sure the refrigerator is closed.

tasks.name: can_meat
tasks.instruction: Open the kitchen cabinet, take out the two hinged jars, open them, place exactly two cooked bratwursts from the chopping board on the countertop into each jar, then close both jars, put them back inside the cabinet, and close the cabinet.

tasks.name: setting_mousetraps
tasks.instruction: Take the four mousetraps from the cabinet in the bathroom and place them on the bathroom floor. Make sure all four end up on the same floor surface, and ensure that at least two of them are either under or directly next to the same bathroom sink.

tasks.name: hiding_Easter_eggs
tasks.instruction: Take the three Easter eggs out of the wicker basket on the lawn in the garden, then place them on the lawn next to a single tree (choose any tree) so that all three eggs are next to the same tree and none are left in the basket.

tasks.name: picking_up_toys
tasks.instruction: Put all the toys in the child's room - the three board games (two on the bed and one on the table), the two jigsaw puzzles on the table, and the tennis ball on the table - inside the toy box on the table in the child's room.

tasks.name: rearranging_kitchen_furniture
tasks.instruction: Move the toaster, food processor, and French press from the kitchen countertop into the same kitchen cabinet, and make sure that cabinet is closed at the end.

tasks.name: putting_up_Christmas_decorations_inside
tasks.instruction: In the living room, take the wreath, three candy canes, and two pillar candles out of the wicker basket. Place the wreath and two of the candy canes on the same living-room sofa. Put the remaining candy cane on top of a dining-room table. Put both pillar candles together on top of one dining-room table (they can share the same table). Finally, place all three gift boxes under or right next to the Christmas tree in the living room.

tasks.name: set_up_a_coffee_station_in_your_kitchen
tasks.instruction: Set up a coffee station on the kitchen countertop: keep the coffee maker on the countertop, move the bottle of coffee from the kitchen shelf to the counter next to the coffee maker, place a paper coffee filter on top of the coffee maker, put the saucer next to the coffee maker with the coffee cup on the saucer, and place the electric kettle next to the coffee maker.

tasks.name: putting_dishes_away_after_cleaning
tasks.instruction: In the kitchen, gather all eight plates from the two countertops, place them all inside a single cabinet (either one), and make sure all cabinets are closed when you're done.

tasks.name: preparing_lunch_box
tasks.instruction: Put both apple halves, the club sandwich, and the chocolate chip cookie from the chopping board on the kitchen countertop into the packing box on the countertop. Then take the bottle of tea out of the refrigerator, put it into the same box, and close the refrigerator when you're done.

tasks.name: loading_the_car
tasks.instruction: Put the digital camera from the living room table into the container on the living room floor. Then take the container and the tennis racket to the garage, place both in the car trunk, and close it.

tasks.name: carrying_in_groceries
tasks.instruction: Take the sack of groceries out of the car trunk in the garage, bring it to the kitchen, and put both the tomato and the carton of milk into the refrigerator in the kitchen. When you're done, close the car trunk and make sure the refrigerator in the kitchen is closed.

tasks.name: bringing_in_wood
tasks.instruction: Bring the three plywood sheets from the garden into the corridor and place them on the floor there.

tasks.name: moving_boxes_to_storage
tasks.instruction: Move the two storage containers from the living room to the garage. In the garage, place one container on the floor and stack the other container on top of it (either order is fine).

tasks.name: bringing_water
tasks.instruction: Retrieve the two bottles from the refrigerator in the kitchen, bring them to the living room, and place both on the coffee table. Make sure the refrigerator is closed when you finish.

tasks.name: tidying_bedroom
tasks.instruction: In the bedroom, move the book from the bed onto either nightstand, and place the two sandals side by side next to the bed.

tasks.name: outfit_a_basic_toolbox
tasks.instruction: In the utility room, put the drill, pliers, flashlight, Allen wrench, and screwdriver from the tabletop into the toolbox, keep the toolbox on the tabletop, and close the toolbox.

tasks.name: sorting_vegetables
tasks.instruction: Sort the vegetables from the two wicker baskets on the kitchen floor into the mixing bowls on the kitchen countertop: put all three bok choy and all three Vidalia onions together into one mixing bowl; put both leeks and both broccoli together into a second mixing bowl; and put all three sweet corn into a third mixing bowl.

tasks.name: collecting_childrens_toys
tasks.instruction: Pick up the two dice from the bed, the two teddy bears from the floor, and the two board games (one from the desk and one from the bed), and place them all inside the same bookcase in the child's room.

tasks.name: putting_shoes_on_rack
tasks.instruction: Pick up the two gym shoes and the two sandals from the corridor floor and place them onto the hallstand (shoe rack) in the corridor, making sure they are on the rack and not on the floor. Arrange them so the two gym shoes are next to each other and the two sandals are next to each other.

tasks.name: boxing_books_up_for_storage
tasks.instruction: Put all six books from the bookcases in the living room into the box on the living room floor.

tasks.name: storing_food
tasks.instruction: Put away all the food on the kitchen countertop by storing it inside the kitchen cabinets: move the two boxes of oatmeal, two bags of chips, two bottles of olive oil, and two jars of sugar from the countertop into the kitchen cabinets (each item can go into either cabinet).

tasks.name: clearing_food_from_table_into_fridge
tasks.instruction: Pack the half chicken and the half apple pie from the plates on the breakfast table into the two tupperware containers from the countertop, then put both tupperware containers inside the refrigerator in the kitchen and make sure the refrigerator is closed at the end.

tasks.name: assembling_gift_baskets
tasks.instruction: Place one candle, one butter cookie, one piece of Swiss cheese, and one bow from the table into each of the four wicker baskets on the floor in the living room.

tasks.name: sorting_household_items
tasks.instruction: From the two baskets on the bedroom floor, take out the items and organize them in the bathroom: place both detergent bottles under the bathroom sink next to each other; put the box of sanitary napkins on the bathroom shelf; set the soap dispenser on the sink; make sure the cup remains on the sink; put both the toothpaste tube and the toothbrush inside the cup.

tasks.name: getting_organized_for_work
tasks.instruction: In the bedroom, organize the workspace by keeping the computer under the desk, ensuring the monitor is on the desk, placing the keyboard on the desk next to the monitor, placing the mouse on the desk next to the keyboard, moving the folder from the swivel chair onto the desk next to the mouse, stacking the notebook on top of the folder with the pen on top of the notebook, and positioning the swivel chair next to the desk.

tasks.name: clean_up_your_desk
tasks.instruction: In the child's room, clean up the desk: put both folders and both paperback books into the bookcase; put the pencil and both pens into the pencil case and leave the case on the desk; take the stapler out of the bookcase and place it on the desk; move the laptop from the bed onto the desk and close it.

tasks.name: setting_the_fire
tasks.instruction: In the living room, place the newspaper from the table into the wood fireplace, then put both pieces of firewood from the floor on top of the newspaper. Use the cigar lighter to ignite any one of the items so that the whole pile catches fire, and then turn the lighter off.

tasks.name: clean_boxing_gloves
tasks.instruction: Wash the two dusty boxing gloves from the countertop in the utility room in the washer until they are no longer covered with dust.

tasks.name: wash_a_baseball_cap
tasks.instruction: Wash the two baseball caps on the countertop in the utility room using the washer until they are no longer dirty.

tasks.name: wash_dog_toys
tasks.instruction: In the utility room, take the two teddy toys, the tennis ball, and the softball out of the cabinet and wash them in the washer so that both teddies are free of dirt and dust, the tennis ball has no debris, and the softball has no dirt.

tasks.name: hanging_pictures
tasks.instruction: Pick up the poster from the kitchen countertop and hang it on one of the wall nails in the kitchen.

tasks.name: attach_a_camera_to_a_tripod
tasks.instruction: Attach the digital camera to the camera tripod in the bedroom.

tasks.name: clean_a_patio
tasks.instruction: Pick up the broom in the garden and sweep the mud off the patio floor until the floor is no longer covered in mud.

tasks.name: clean_a_trumpet
tasks.instruction: In the bedroom, pick up the scrub brush from the desk and scrub the cornet (trumpet) on the desk until it's no longer covered in dust.

tasks.name: spraying_for_bugs
tasks.instruction: Pick up the pesticide atomizer in the garden and spray insectifuge to fully cover both potted plants in the garden.

tasks.name: spraying_fruit_trees
tasks.instruction: In the garden, pick up the pesticide atomizer on the floor and spray pesticide onto both trees until each tree trunk is fully covered.

tasks.name: make_microwave_popcorn
tasks.instruction: In the kitchen, take the popcorn bag from the countertop, put it into the microwave, and heat it until the popcorn is cooked so the cooked popcorn ends up inside the bag.

tasks.name: cook_cabbage
tasks.instruction: From the kitchen refrigerator, take the cabbage and the chili, dice them on the chopping board with the knife, cook the diced cabbage and diced chili in the frying pan on the stove, and leave the cooked, diced cabbage and cooked, diced chili in the frying pan.

tasks.name: chop_an_onion
tasks.instruction: In the kitchen, take the Vidalia onion out of the sink, dice it on the chopping board with the paring knife, put the diced onion into the bowl on the countertop, then place both the paring knife and the chopping board into the sink.

tasks.name: slicing_vegetables
tasks.instruction: From the refrigerator in the kitchen, take out the two bell peppers, the two beets, and the zucchini. Then, on either chopping board on the countertop, use the parer to dice all of them so that only diced bell pepper, diced beet, and diced zucchini remain. Make sure the refrigerator is closed when you finish.

tasks.name: chopping_wood
tasks.instruction: Chop the four logs on the driveway in the garden into eight half logs using the axe and the chopping block.

tasks.name: cook_hot_dogs
tasks.instruction: Take the two hot dogs out of the refrigerator in the kitchen and cook them in the microwave until both are cooked.

tasks.name: cook_bacon
tasks.instruction: Take the tray with six slices of bacon out of the refrigerator in the kitchen, cook all six slices in the frying pan on the stove until they're cooked, and make sure the refrigerator is closed when you're done.

tasks.name: freeze_pies
tasks.instruction: In the kitchen, take the two apple pies from the plates on the countertop, put each pie into a separate tupperware container taken from the cabinet, place both tupperwares inside the refrigerator, close the refrigerator, and leave them until the pies are frozen.

tasks.name: canning_food
tasks.instruction: In the kitchen, open the refrigerator and the cabinet. Take the steak and the pineapple out of the refrigerator and take two bowls from the cabinet. On the chopping board on the countertop, use the carving knife to dice the steak and to dice the pineapple. Put only the diced steak into one bowl and only the diced pineapple into the other bowl - do not mix them. Place both bowls back inside the cabinet, then close the refrigerator and close the cabinet.

tasks.name: make_pizza
tasks.instruction: Make a pizza on the cookie sheet in the kitchen: take the grated cheese, the four pieces of pepperoni, and the two mushrooms from their tupperware containers in the refrigerator; chop the Vidalia onion on the chopping board with the knife, and also chop the two whole mushrooms in half; top the pizza dough that's already on the cookie sheet with the cheese, pepperoni, halved mushrooms, and chopped onion; bake it in the oven until it becomes a pizza, and leave the finished pizza on the cookie sheet.

tasks.name: freeze_fruit
tasks.instruction: In the kitchen, take the two tupperware containers from the cabinet, put one apple and one strawberry into each container, place both containers in the refrigerator, and leave the fruit frozen.

tasks.name: cook_a_brisket
tasks.instruction: Take the brisket from the refrigerator, cook it in a frying pan on the burner, and place the cooked brisket on the chopping board.

tasks.name: sorting_bottles_cans_and_paper
tasks.instruction: Sort the recyclables into separate containers: put the bottles together in one bucket, the cans together in another bucket, and the newspaper and magazine together in a third bucket.

tasks.name: tidying_living_room
tasks.instruction: In the living room, place the potted plant on the coffee table and put the books and papers into the bookcase.

tasks.name: putting_away_toys
tasks.instruction: Pick up all the toy figures from the floor and put them inside the toy boxes.

tasks.name: re_shelving_library_books
tasks.instruction: Put the library books and notebooks from the desk into the bookcase.

tasks.name: make_rose_centerpieces
tasks.instruction: Place all four roses into the vase and leave the vase on the coffee table.

tasks.name: sweeping_garage
tasks.instruction: Use the broom to sweep the dirt from the garage floor until the floor is clean.

tasks.name: stacking_wood
tasks.instruction: Stack all of the logs together on the driveway.

tasks.name: organizing_art_supplies
tasks.instruction: Put the marker, paintbrush, glue stick, and rubber eraser into the tote, then place the tote on the desk.

tasks.name: scrubbing_bathroom_floor
tasks.instruction: Use the scrub brush to scrub the bathroom floor until the floor is clean.

tasks.name: bringing_paper_to_recycling
tasks.instruction: Put the paper and newspaper into the recycling bin, then close the recycling bin.

tasks.name: halve_an_egg
tasks.instruction: Take the hard-boiled egg from the refrigerator, cut it in half on the cutting board, and leave the egg halves on the plate.

tasks.name: installing_smoke_detectors
tasks.instruction: Attach the two smoke detectors to the wall nails.

tasks.name: setting_the_table
tasks.instruction: Set the breakfast table with both plates, put one cupcake on each plate, and place a fork and a knife next to each plate.

tasks.name: unloading_the_car
tasks.instruction: Open the car, take out the briefcase and satchel, and place them on the floor outside the car.

tasks.name: turning_out_all_lights_before_sleep
tasks.instruction: Turn off all of the lights and light switches before sleep.

tasks.name: boxing_food_after_dinner
tasks.instruction: Pack the food from the plates into the tupperware container, put the container in the refrigerator, and close the refrigerator.

tasks.name: cleaning_up_branches_and_twigs
tasks.instruction: Collect all of the branches and twigs from the garden and put them into the recycling bin.

tasks.name: vacuuming_floors
tasks.instruction: Use the vacuum to clean the dirty floor until the floor is no longer covered in dirt.

tasks.name: thawing_frozen_food
tasks.instruction: Take the frozen food from the refrigerator, put it in the microwave, and heat it until it is thawed.

tasks.name: clean_your_rusty_garden_tools
tasks.instruction: Use the steel wool to clean the rust off the garden tools, then put the tools into the toolbox.

tasks.name: cook_a_frozen_pie
tasks.instruction: Take the frozen apple pie from the refrigerator, put it in the oven, and heat it until it is hot and no longer frozen.

tasks.name: organizing_school_stuff
tasks.instruction: Put the school supplies into the tote, place the tote on the bed, and keep the folder and notebook next to it.

tasks.name: carrying_out_garden_furniture
tasks.instruction: Carry the garden chairs and wheelbarrow out to the lawn.

tasks.name: put_together_a_basic_pruning_kit
tasks.instruction: Put the pruner and shears into the toolbox, then close the toolbox.

tasks.name: dispose_of_glass
tasks.instruction: Pick up the water glasses and put them into the trash can.

tasks.name: installing_a_modem
tasks.instruction: Install the modem by placing it on the cabinet and turning it on.

tasks.name: make_cabinet_doors
tasks.instruction: Attach the cabinet door to the cabinet base.

tasks.name: polishing_shoes
tasks.instruction: Use the scrub brush to polish both shoes until the stains are removed.

tasks.name: clean_up_broken_glass
tasks.instruction: Pick up all of the broken glass pieces and put them into the trash can.

tasks.name: packing_meal_for_delivery
tasks.instruction: Pack each wrapped hamburger into a paper bag, then put the paper bags into the storage box.

tasks.name: store_batteries
tasks.instruction: Put all of the batteries into the bottom-cabinet drawer, then close the drawer.

tasks.name: store_honey
tasks.instruction: Put the jar of honey into the cabinet drawer, then close the drawer.

tasks.name: tidying_bathroom
tasks.instruction: Tidy the bathroom by putting the toilet tissue on the toilet, placing the tissue dispenser and soap dish on the countertop, putting the soap in the soap dish, and throwing the cork into the trash can.

tasks.name: putting_dirty_dishes_in_sink
tasks.instruction: Put all of the dirty bowls and plates into the kitchen sink.

tasks.name: make_gift_bags_for_baby_showers
tasks.instruction: Make baby-shower gift bags by putting a toy die and a wafer into each paper bag.

tasks.name: collecting_aluminum_cans
tasks.instruction: Collect all of the soda cans and put them into the ice bucket.

tasks.name: rearrange_your_room
tasks.instruction: Rearrange the room by putting the pillows on the bed, moving the chair next to the desk, and placing the tissue dispenser on the nightstand.

tasks.name: installing_a_fax_machine
tasks.instruction: Install the fax machine by placing it on the cubicle desk and turning it on.

tasks.name: composting_waste
tasks.instruction: Put the food waste into the compost bin.

tasks.name: store_produce
tasks.instruction: Take the mangoes and pomegranates from the basket and put them into the refrigerator.

tasks.name: installing_a_scanner
tasks.instruction: Install the scanner by turning it on and leaving it on the desk near the laptop.

tasks.name: clean_a_keyboard
tasks.instruction: Use the pipe cleaner to clean the keyboard until the stain is removed.

tasks.name: dispose_of_batteries
tasks.instruction: Pick up all of the batteries and put them into the trash can.

tasks.name: cook_brussels_sprouts
tasks.instruction: Take the brussels sprouts from the refrigerator, cut them on the cutting board, put the pieces onto the baking sheet, and cook them in the oven.

tasks.name: cook_broccolini
tasks.instruction: Cook the broccolini in the frying pan on the stove.

tasks.name: setup_a_bar_for_a_cocktail_party
tasks.instruction: Set up the bar for a cocktail party by placing the wineglasses, wine bottle, corkscrew, soda cans, and ice bucket on the bar.

tasks.name: laying_tile_floors
tasks.instruction: Lay the ceramic tiles on the floor next to each other.

tasks.name: sorting_books_on_shelf
tasks.instruction: Sort the comic books, notebooks, and hardbacks on the bookcase shelves so the books of each type are grouped together.
